instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. In front of a wooden house, the man in the purple hoodie (R1) stands in the center foreground with arms crossed, smiling widely showing his teeth. Behind him, the woman in the yellow sweatshirt (R2) hugs him from behind, wrapping her arms over his shoulders and chest while smiling widely at the camera. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene with warm tones.
